purpose: Synthesize previously frozen paired interventions into an outcome-tiered causal pricing rule catalog
scientific_scope: Controlled LLM-agent simulator only; no direct real-market causal claim

provenance.candidate_generation: Negotiation-derived implicit-factor taxonomy and M1 decision-tree paths
provenance.chat_rule_adaptation: Generate candidates from semantic and structural samples, rank with observed evidence, then require a separate causal intervention before promotion

causal_contrast: Within each pair, treatment confirms one grounded product property while control leaves that same property unresolved

evidence_tiers.candidate_only: Observational or tree-path rule without successful paired intervention
evidence_tiers.causal_wtp_rule: Paired intervention changes effective willingness to pay in the expected direction with multiplicity-controlled evidence
evidence_tiers.causal_transaction_rule: Causal WTP rule that also changes agreement probability under its prespecified test
evidence_tiers.strict_causal_negotiated_price_rule: A preregistered paired intervention also passes the negotiated-price propagation criterion among pairs agreeing under both arms

primary_confirmation_requirements.primary_value_rules: Use predecessor Bonferroni decisions without redefining hypotheses
primary_confirmation_requirements.negotiated_price: Use the predecessor preregistered price-propagation decision
